continuity_cutline.description: Subjects at or above Stable carry the cleared continuity claim; a continuity gap on a still-stable subject holds promotion through the shiproom gate.

rules.title: Primary owner vacant
rules.rationale: A still-stable subject that narrows on primary owner vacant holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

rules.title: No backup owner (single-person system)
rules.rationale: A still-stable subject that narrows on backup owner missing holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

rules.title: Roster below quorum
rules.rationale: A still-stable subject that narrows on roster quorum below threshold holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

rules.title: Backup runbook stale
rules.rationale: A still-stable subject that narrows on runbook stale holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

rules.title: Backup runbook missing
rules.rationale: A still-stable subject that narrows on runbook missing holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

rules.title: Split authority unmet

rules.title: Shiproom escalation missing
rules.rationale: A still-stable subject that narrows on shiproom escalation missing holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

rules.title: Continuity proof stale

records.title: Framework release-artifact signing
records.subject_summary: Release-artifact signing for the core framework train.
records.rationale: Named primary and backup owners, a three-signer roster at quorum, enforced split authority, a current runbook, and a raised escalation; the lane is cleared.

records.title: Notebook promotion-gate approval
records.subject_summary: Promotion-gate approval quorum for the notebook train.
records.rationale: The promotion-approval lane has a single owner with no named backup: it is a single-person system and narrows on the backup axis even though the lane is escalated. A still-stable subject, so it holds promotion.

records.title: Managed-depth release-artifact signing
records.rationale: The signer roster carries one available signer against a quorum of three; the lane narrows on the quorum axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: AI-adjacent security response
records.subject_summary: Advisory, CVE/GHSA, and revocation response for AI-adjacent surfaces.
records.rationale: A blocking security-response lane whose split (two-person) authority is unmet and whose shiproom escalation is still pending; it narrows on the authority axis and holds promotion.

records.title: Companion registry moderation
records.subject_summary: Extension-registry moderation and emergency unpublish for the companion surfaces.
records.rationale: The registry-moderation lane has owners and operators but no captured backup runbook; it narrows on the runbook axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Data-rich registry moderation
records.rationale: The lane has no named primary owner; it narrows on the owner axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited and gated upstream.

records.title: Review promotion-gate approval
records.subject_summary: Promotion-gate approval quorum for review/diff surfaces.

waiver.reason: Backup owner onboarding in progress; covered by an approved, time-boxed waiver.

records.rationale: A single-owner promotion-approval lane held by an unexpired waiver: it stays visible and narrowed on the backup axis but is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Managed-depth security response
records.subject_summary: Advisory and revocation response for managed-depth services.
records.rationale: The continuity proof packet aged past its freshness SLO; the lane narrows on the stale axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited.

records.title: Managed-depth registry moderation
records.subject_summary: Registry moderation for managed-depth marketplace surfaces.
records.rationale: No continuity proof packet is captured; the lane narrows on the stale axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited.

records.title: Framework security response
records.subject_summary: Advisory, CVE/GHSA, and revocation response for the core framework.
records.rationale: Named primary and backup owners, a responder roster at quorum, enforced split authority, a runbook due for review (a reminder, not a gap), and a raised escalation; the lane is cleared.

scan_surface_parity.rationale: Every record's continuity scan and governance surface agree, so a green authority card can never mask a single-owner, under-quorum, or runbook-less lane.

publication.rationale: Hold while any release-blocking subject carries a continuity gap on a still-stable claim; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream. A single-owner, under-quorum, or runbook-less protected lane may not widen a stable claim without coverage.
